intro: Lesson 29: Important Lessons unit 1: al-Fatihah, the Opening. To understand what Surah al-Fatihah means and why every Muslim must learn it correctly

questions.q: Explain what 'You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help' (1:5) teaches.
questions.a: Worship and seeking help belong to Allah alone: this is tawheed in a single ayah.
questions.model: Point: ayah 5 is tawheed. Evidence: 'You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help' (1:5). Explain: 'You' comes first in the Arabic to show only Allah. Link: we say it in every rak'ah.

questions.a: Master of the Day of Judgement
options: Master of the Day of Judgement

questions.q: Meaning map on the pupil PDF: write each ayah of al-Fatihah in Arabic (from the mushaf) with its meaning and one thing it asks of me. Long answer in the portal response box: 'Al-Fatihah teaches me ...'
questions.a: Seven ayat with meanings; a paragraph on praise, tawheed and asking for guidance
questions.model: Teacher does ayah 2: الحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ: 'All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds'. It asks me to thank Allah for everything.

questions.q: who are 'those who have earned anger' and 'those astray' in ayah 7, in general terms?
questions.a: Those who knew the truth and left it, and those who acted without knowledge

questions.q: recite al-Fatihah to a partner and check each other's makharij.
Back to our ponder: how will you think about al-Fatihah in your next salah?
